bio.text: Josh Hawley is a U.S. Senator from Missouri and serves on the Senate Committees on the Judiciary; Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs; Health, Education, Labor and Pensions; and Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
He previously served as Missouri's Attorney General.
He is a native of Lexington, Missouri, graduated from Stanford University in 2002 and Yale Law School in 2006, and has litigated before the U.S. Supreme Court.
